parsed.post: Latest experiment (1.036892) was a regression from my best (1.024852). The depth reduction to 4 was likely the cause. Reverting to depth 6. I'll now try decreasing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 to see if more optimizer steps help convergence within the 5-minute limit.
parsed.description: Revert to DEPTH=6 and reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
